companyFieldUpdates.description: Prospect Power is an operating 150 MW / 600 MWh four-hour standalone battery-energy-storage project in Rockingham County, Virginia, serving PJM and northern Virginia load through a 15-year Dominion Energy Virginia power-purchase arrangement. Swift Current Energy acquired the project from Clean Planet Renewable Energy in 2023 while Swift was controlled by IFM-managed funds. IFM reports that Swift completed the sale to Elevate in December 2025, while January 15, 2026 company releases announced the already-completed transfer. Elevate, an ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII platform, is the current owner and operator, and the project was operating by June 2026. Prospect Power, LLC and tariff successor Lighthouse Prospect Power, LLC are treated as one project identity; Swift and Elevate are sponsor platforms rather than duplicate PortCos. Public sources do not disclose the exact sale-closing day, project-level ownership percentage or immediate acquisition SPV, and no later sale or signed pending transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
